interfaces.name: battery_input
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read battery_input, initial_soc, available_capacity_Ah, forecast_discharge_current_A, reserve_capacity_Ah, and required_landing_time_s from the MATLAB base workspace. battery_input is a Timeseries with two real input channels [positive-discharge current in A, battery temperature in K]. interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run Timeseries named electrical_state, identified_3rc, and rul_state. electrical_state has width 4 in this order: terminal voltage (V), estimated terminal voltage (V), plant SOC (unitless fraction), and estimated SOC (unitless fraction).

interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run Timeseries named electrical_state, identified_3rc, and rul_state. identified_3rc has width 8 in this order: R0 (ohm), R1 (ohm), C1 (F), R2 (ohm), C2 (F), R3 (ohm), C3 (F), and estimated available capacity (A*h).

interfaces.name: rul_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run Timeseries named electrical_state, identified_3rc, and rul_state. rul_state has width 4 in this order: consumed charge (A*h), remaining usable capacity before reserve (A*h), predicted RUL (s), and landing safety margin (s).
